lines.zh: 我走在藤蔓上，像一颗熟透的果子。
lines.en: I walk the vines, a ripe fruit on legs.

lines.zh: 粉红的鳞在叶影里发亮。
lines.en: Pink scales shine through the leaf shade.
Four legs grip the vines, steady.

lines.zh: 成年龙在前后，我跟着走。
lines.en: The adults flank me; I keep pace.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，果子都晃。
lines.en: The fruit sways where I pass.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过一片蕨叶。
lines.en: My tail brushes a fern frond.

lines.zh: 我抬头看树冠，那里有光。
lines.en: I look up at the canopy, where the light is.
My steps are soft; the jungle is noisy.

lines.zh: 我走一段，回头确认幼崽。
lines.en: I walk a stretch and check on the young.

lines.zh: 丛林里到处都是能藏身的地方。
lines.en: The jungle offers hiding everywhere.

lines.zh: 我的背上有像果皮一样的纹。
lines.en: My back has marks like fruit skin.

lines.zh: 我贴在树干上，鳞和树皮同色。
lines.en: I cling to the trunk, scales matching bark.

lines.zh: 我挂在藤上，装成一颗果子。
lines.en: I hang on the vine, posing as fruit.

lines.zh: 我的鳞一层层，是淡粉的。
lines.en: My scales layer in pale pink.

lines.zh: 伙伴在树上，我守着下面。
lines.en: My family is above; I guard below.
I hear insects crossing the leaves.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，连尾巴都收着。
lines.en: I keep still, tail tucked in.

lines.zh: 这片果林，我们住了很久。
lines.en: We have lived in this grove a long while.

lines.zh: 我轻轻咬了一下自己的尾巴。
lines.en: I nibble my own tail lightly.
The fruit overhead is not ripe.
I shift position and keep pretending.

lines.zh: 我的小翅膀还飞不起来。
lines.en: My small wings cannot fly yet.
The air is warm and wet. Perfect.
I wait for word from the adults.
A leaf lands on my head.
I blink; my eyes are yellow.
You are standing in our grove.
You are too close to the young.

lines.zh: 我不大，但我们有成年龙。
lines.en: I am small, but we have adults.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，喉咙里滚着低音。
lines.en: I flatten down, a low sound rolling in my throat.
Step back, and I will let you be.

lines.zh: 我歪头，判断你有多危险。
lines.en: I tilt my head, judging how dangerous you are.
Do not reach that way.
I have put myself in front of the young.

lines.zh: 我看得出你不是来吃果子的。
lines.en: I can tell you did not come for fruit.
I hiss, very softly.
This grove is ours.
If you do not move, neither do I.
My scales have risen.
You stepped on our vine.
I am counting how many of you there are.

lines.zh: 你身上没有藤叶和湿土的气味。
lines.en: You carry no smell of vine leaves or wet soil.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，退到叶子后面。
lines.en: I cry out and back behind the leaves.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的鳞掉了两片。
lines.en: Two of my scales came off.
Fifteen health is not much.
My wings are drooping.
I pant hard, throat rasping.
I hide in a hollow.
The adults are calling me.
My legs tremble; I cannot stand steady.
Blood drips onto the vine.

lines.zh: 别再打了，我的鳞已经裂了。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; my scales are already split.
Is that an apple?
I eat apples only. Nothing else.
Hold the apple up a little.
I come close and sniff first.
After this bite, I want more.
The adults are watching too.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我才碰那苹果。
lines.en: Half a step back, and I will touch that apple.
My teeth are small; I chew slowly.
Is there more in your hand?
I take the apple and run back up.
You hit my vine.
I back into the leaves.
I have only fifteen health.

lines.zh: 被这么一撞，我在枝上打了晃。
lines.en: That knock set me swaying on the branch.
Do not crowd; it is narrow here.
The adults are already looking.
I press to the trunk and yield the path.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞上来，比我那棵树还硬。
lines.en: That shoulder hits harder than my tree trunk.
Leaves fell where we collided.
Again, and I will call out.
I am young; that must wait.
Adult matters are not mine.
My tail has not grown out yet.
There are companions in this tree.

lines.zh: 我们在同一片藤上长大。
lines.en: We grew up on the same vines.

lines.zh: 我叫得很难听，会吓到人。
lines.en: My call is ugly; it frightens people.
Do not ask me. Ask the adults.
In the grove, things take time.
First let me see if there is fruit.

lines.zh: 你笑出声，我只顾着看你。
lines.en: You laugh, and I can only stare at you.

lines.zh: 这颗果子掉了，我捡起来。
lines.en: This fruit fell; I pick it up.
I pin it with a claw.

lines.zh: 这果子沉得我爪尖发颤。
lines.en: The fruit is heavy enough to make my claws tremble.
I bite it. Sour.
A vine tendril — I carry it.
I stuff it into a tree hollow.
Not an apple; I put it down.
Something crawls inside the fruit.
I take it to show the young.
It rolled away; I chase.
Something approaches the trellis.
I raise my head; my scales lift.
It is on the young's side.

lines.zh: 我朝树上喊一声，叫成年龙。
lines.en: I call up into the tree for the adults.
The adults heard.

lines.zh: 我伏到藤上，后腿绷紧了。
lines.en: I press to the vine, my hind legs coiled.

lines.zh: 这个位置，我能咬到它的腿。
lines.en: From here I can reach its leg.

lines.zh: 它比我大，但我们不止一个。
lines.en: It is bigger, but we are more than one.
I do not retreat; the nest is behind me.
My throat feels warm.

lines.zh: 我在判断它会不会爬树。
lines.en: I am judging whether it can climb.

lines.zh: 成年龙已经挪到低枝上了。
lines.en: The adults have moved to lower branches.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，几乎贴住藤。
lines.en: I flatten myself almost against the vine.
It has not seen us in the tree.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没从它身上挪开。
lines.en: My eyes have not left it once.

lines.zh: 它转半圈，我也跟着转半圈。
lines.en: It turns half a circle; I turn half with it.
I drive it away from the trellis.
It backed off; I remain.

lines.zh: 尾巴挺得笔直，我随时能扑。
lines.en: My tail is rigid; I can spring at any moment.

lines.zh: 树上还有几只眼睛在看。
lines.en: More eyes watch from the branches.

lines.zh: 它的脚一挪，我的叫声就起。
lines.en: The moment its foot shifts, my cry goes up.
It may not tread on this tree's roots.
Every footfall it makes, I tally.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我们就一起上。
lines.en: One step more and we all go at once.

lines.zh: 我压低声音，怕惊动幼崽。
lines.en: I keep my voice low, so the young are not startled.

lines.zh: 它的影子已经落到藤上了。
lines.en: Its shadow has fallen on the vine.
I wait for the adults to move first.

lines.zh: 它退了半步，我立刻跟上。
lines.en: It gave half a step; I follow at once.
I drive the young higher into the canopy.
I bite its ankle.
This claw only breaks the skin.
I lunge, then pull back.
My teeth are short, but sharp.
One sweep of its arm and I fly.

lines.zh: 我挂在他袖口上，荡来荡去。
lines.en: I hang from his cuff, swinging back and forth.
The adults are behind me.

lines.zh: 我这一下，是给幼崽看的。
lines.en: This blow is for the young to see.
Something is in my throat.
One more bite and I go.
This damage is nothing much.
I pant and retreat behind the tree.
You hit me, but I am standing.
We are not afraid of you.
I hatch in the grove.

lines.zh: 第一眼是绿色的，全是叶子。
lines.en: My first sight is green, all leaves.
An adult watches over me.
My scales are wet and soft.

lines.zh: 我试着站起来，摔了一次。
lines.en: I try to stand and fall once.

lines.zh: 头顶的果子还挂着青色。
lines.en: The fruit overhead still hangs green.
This vine will be ours.
I smell fruit and wet earth.
I shake, and my scales open.

lines.zh: 我跟着成年龙走了一圈。
lines.en: I follow an adult on a round.
The jungle is big and the vines are many.
I choose this low branch.
I open my mouth; only a little sound comes.

lines.zh: 从这里，我能看见整片果林。
lines.en: From here I can see the whole grove.
I decide to guard this side.
Whoever comes, I will see first.
Fire licks my scales. It hurts.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下，叶子接住我一点。
lines.en: I fall from the tree; leaves break it a little.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我乱抓。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I claw wildly.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀到藤架外面。
lines.en: The blast throws me off the trellis.

lines.zh: 箭尖卡在我肩上的鳞缝里。
lines.en: The arrowhead is lodged between the scales of my shoulder.
All my scales have gone cold.
Too hungry to grip the vine.

lines.zh: 雷一响，我整条龙都僵了。
lines.en: The thunder freezes my whole body.

lines.zh: 下面没有树，只有往下掉的空。
lines.en: No trees below, only falling emptiness.
